validation.unitTests: 20 passed on iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.5, including option layout and bilingual resource tests.
validation.uiTests: All 11 iPhone scenarios passed in a full run. Additional review-action flow passed on iPhone; review/retry and adaptive portrait/landscape screenshot flows passed on iPad.
validation.deviceBuild: Xcode 27.2 generic iOS Debug build succeeded with Apple Development signing; verified CloudKit container and Development environment in signed entitlements
validation.screenshots: Captured running iPhone/iPad app with isolated UI-test data; landscape capture uses XCUIScreen to retain correct orientation metadata
validation.result: Question selection, English tutor drafts, native vocabulary selection, live settings sheet theme changes and persistence, generation/cancel, review/retry, history and mock navigation passed simulator tests.
validation.toolchainNote: Xcode emitted App Intents metadata/diagnostic collection warnings; no app compile errors.

limitations: Live ChatGPT sign-in, usage limits, generation and inference require the user account; no live authenticated request was made during this task.
Speaking feedback uses the transcript; pronunciation and acoustic fluency are explicitly unevaluated. No fabricated audio score is included.
On-device English recognition requires supported device/language assets and permission; manual transcript entry remains available.
Scores and CEFR are formative estimates, not calibrated official IELTS results.
Microphone capture and transcription need a physical-device permission/audio check.
Native iOS navigation and sheet geometry adapt to device size and OS; Figma content, colors, typography and functional states are the reference.
Live two-device CloudKit transfer remains unverified; schema must be deployed to Production before TestFlight/App Store. Background push sync is not implemented.
Historical plain-text readingHistory entries remain local; current structured results synchronize.
Generation percentage is a clearly labeled elapsed-time estimate, not server-reported completion. Loading screenshot uses a DEBUG-only UI-test fixture.
